bio_en: Artem Odabashian fought in Baku, Yerevan, Shushi and around Goris in Zangezur and was known as one of the ARF's boldest operatives. In 1907, like others, he briefly joined the dissident 'Young Dashnaks', but returned to the party after the Vienna General Congress. In September 1908 he and his comrade Nikol crossed into Persia to join the constitutional revolution. Both were killed by head wounds in the fighting there and were buried in the courtyard of the Lilava school in Tabriz, described as the first Armenian victims of the Persian liberation movement.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year inferred: killed soon after crossing into Persia in Sept 1908 (Droshak Jan 1911); exact date not given. Quote author 'Artem (Odabashian)'.
